title: Mermaid Diagram
description:
Stage 9 artifact for the technical_assessment path (AI §9.1). Rendered from the architecture components rather than generated.

NODES MATCH COMPONENTS BY CONSTRUCTION. AI §9.1 requires it, and rendering rather than generating is how it is guaranteed: a diagram naming a component the architecture does not have has no way to occur. node_count is carried so the correspondence is checkable without parsing the diagram source.

WHY THE SOURCE IS A STRING. Mermaid is a text format; storing it as structured nodes and edges would mean re-serialising it before anything could render it, and the renderer is the consumer.

diagram.description: Mermaid source. Begins with a flowchart declaration or no renderer will accept it.

node_count.description: Component count. A diagram of nothing is not a diagram.
